item.title: Version 0.4.0
item.description: New look: the torrent list shows each download with an icon for what it is, a readable name (El Batal · S01E05 with 1080p, WEB-DL tags), a coloured progress bar and the numbers that matter, under live download and upload graphs; the old table is one click away in the toolbar. Search has a big search field, suggestions, result cards with score rings and coloured quality tags, and a Telegram card. New inspector, Other Downloads, menu bar panel and setup assistant. Fix: results found by earlier searches no longer disappear when the first site answers.

item.title: Version 0.3.1
item.description: Sites to search in your browser: save the sites you search yourself, and Search shows a button for each one (plus Open All) that opens that site's own search for what you typed, in your browser. To add a site, search it for torpal and paste the results page address, or paste just the site's address to search it through Google.

item.title: Version 0.3.0
item.description: Arabic sources: Sites with an Account (ArabP2P and others; sign up, then enter just your login, and private torrents keep seeding to ratio 1.0 or 72 hours); Arabic-aware search (also tries Arabic, ArSub, Shahid and مدبلج tags); Internet Archive built in for classic films; SubSource Arabic subtitles alongside SubDL; Telegram: sign in with your own account to search and download videos from your channels and groups (Settings › Telegram); Download from Web Page (⇧⌘D) into the new Other Downloads list. Also: Add Public Sites in one click, a SubDL key check, and a new app icon.

item.title: Version 0.2.1
item.description: Beta fixes: Prowlarr no longer fails when its port is taken (it moves to a free one) and start errors show right away; the TMDB token is checked when you save it, with a Test button in Settings › Search and a live check in Diagnostics (the short TMDB API Key works too).

item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description: Beta: speed profiles, battery and heat back-off, VPN lock and kill switch, IP blocklist, phone remote control, diagnostics, setup assistant, settings export/import, Quick Look, Finder tags and auto-rename, custom indexer definitions, Arabic subtitle hints, crash reports.

item.title: Version 0.1.0
item.description: TorPal 0.1.0 — first daily-driver build: downloads, add sheet with file selection, inspector, browser/Finder integration, menu bar, settings, watched folder, notifications.
